title: Career development opportunities.
bodyText: The department shall provide career pathways development and training opportunities to all school health assistants in the school health services field and other fields within the department to ensure the opportunity for continued employment with the department.
bodyHtml: §302A-708  Career development opportunities.  The department shall provide career pathways development and training opportunities to all school health assistants in the school health services field and other fields within the department to ensure the opportunity for continued employment with the department. [L 2007, c 105, §4; am L 2023, c 173, §3]
